# Test fixtures

Most format fixtures are generated by the tests themselves (see `test/helpers.ts`). These two can't be generated in JavaScript and come from the test suites of the libraries that read them:

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `sample.doc` | [`node-word-extractor`](https://github.com/morungos/node-word-extractor), `__tests__/data/test11.doc` | MIT |
| `sample.msg` | [`msgreader`](https://github.com/HiraokaHyperTools/msgreader), `test/attachmentFiles.msg` | Apache-2.0 |
